items.summary: fix(gateway): make config.patch errors name the problem and the working next step (#124127) Three dead-end error texts in config.patch, per the never-dead-end-the-agent doctrine (failure text states what to try next): - "invalid config; fix before patching" hid the actual validation issues the handler already had in the snapshot; it now summarizes them (same summarizeConfigValidationIssues owner the sibling validation errors use), attaches structured details, and names openclaw doctor as the fix path. - The hashless-LWW rejection said "re-run config.get and retry" — wrong advice, since retrying hash-free fails identically; it now names the exact guarded paths and says to retry with baseHash. - The mutation-conflict handler appended "re-run config.get and retry" to every conflict; non-retryable conflicts (path ownership) fail the retry too, so the suffix is now gated on error.retryable. Both new regression tests fail pre-fix.
